Live cards + minions list + composer proven on a standalone harness (test/test.html + chat-test.css), real API data, zero console errors. Found and fixed a real bug: flex-shrink defaults to 1, so a column of many cards inside a height-capped ancestor (.dev-chat-minions max-height, or a long log) squishes every card to ~0.3px instead of overflowing and letting overflow-y:auto scroll — the automatic minimum size of a flex item with overflow:hidden content is 0. Fix: flex-shrink:0 on .dev-chat-card and .dev-chat-minion. 81 real minion cards and 8+ live-session cards confirmed readable after the fix.

Health-check alarm investigated: /framework/dev/DevBar/ was NOT broken by says.js. Root cause was a sibling task (server-self) crashing the shared dev server via a bug in Server/plugins/SocketServer/LiveReload.js (this.socket_server.sockets not iterable) after editing Server/run.js — took my private :8139 server down as collateral (same supervised Server/ code, same file watch). The sibling fixed it (confirmed live in the mastermind log itself, visible on my restarted :8139 server); restarted my server, confirmed the DevBar page renders fully and correctly, zero console errors, screenshot taken. says.js/timeline.js were never the cause.

says.js/timeline.js CSS written to devbar.css (author colors, dot/status, pinned strip, flash, caret/streaming, full-text body, log fills the page tab). Found and fixed a real overlap bug: the pinned needs-you strip had no bound and painted over the ROUTE section below when it grew past available space (min-height:0 flex-shrink); fixed with pinned-strip max-height+scroll plus overflow:hidden on the log section as a second guard. Gap investigation for the owner: measured 70 consecutive card pairs, every gap identical (3.19px, 0px margins) regardless of author -- no differing rule existed; fixed the real gap (an explicit gap added to .dev-says-card-main, which had none) since the missing rule is what read as inconsistent. Verified live on :8139, zero console errors, screenshot clean.

Padding measurement for the owner/auditor, BEFORE any change: .dev-says-card padding is currently 5.12px/6.4px (0.4em 0.5em, hand-written in devbar.css, card font-size 12.8px) -- this rule wins over frameworks own .btn/button padding var(--pad-control) rule because a class selector beats a bare element selector. Testing --pad directly (temporarily set padding: var(--pad) on the same card, and separately on a probe div in .dev-body, bar width 271px): --pad resolves to 12.7969px -- exactly 1em at this font-size, i.e. it correctly hit its OWN 1em clamp floor at this narrow width (2.6% of 271px minus 1.1em is negative, so clamp floors it). --pad itself is working as designed; the bug is that .dev-says-card never used var(--pad) at all -- it hardcoded a smaller value instead. Fixing now: padding: var(--pad) on .dev-says-card.

Card meta line (dot/author/time) moved above the text as its own row, so text always starts at the same left x regardless of author/pinned state (was: beside the text, different x per card). Padding switched from a hardcoded 0.4em 0.5em to var(--pad) per the design system. Verified live on :8139, screenshot clean, zero console errors.

V3 padding measured at the owner/auditor request: .v3-tile padding is UNIFORM on all four sides -- 16px at 1920, 18px at 3440 (var(--pad), a BUTTON element, first child .v3-tile-head margin-top 0px) -- no zero-top-padding found in the current code. Added status color-coding (tinted ground + left edge, needs-you/working/done, tints kept to 5-10% so text contrast is unaffected). Per-card routing (a real /framework/ai/v/3/<id>/ url) is real core/Page route() work -- deferred, documented as a follow-up, consistent with the earlier V3-scope triage note.

Health-check caught a real bug from my own edit: a leftover .append_to(page.url ? undefined : null) line called undefined.append(this), crashing every V3 tile render. Fixed by removing the line (v3-cards div.c() auto-appends via the normal capture form, no explicit append_to needed). Verified clean immediately after.

V3 final batch landed: white cards + left-edge-only status color, no default icon guess, no title clamp, first-sentence + author on the face, toolbar (grid/timeline view switch + track-width slider, Page.Store + ?view=), real per-card routing (/v/3/<id>/, back/forward/reload all verified headless), nested-card preview gated on parent field, focus-weight bonus (newest focus:true card gets a decaying 10-min bonus) with bigger icon on big cards. Dev bar: chat tab first/default, path bar in the head, mastermind log fills the page tab with full text -- all verified at 1280/3440/400 with zero console errors. Composer append mechanism verified against a scratch file. Moving to documentation + finish-task now.
